title: Mineralized
summary: MIN'ERALIZED, participle passive Deprived of its usual properties by being combined with another substance or formed into an ore; as, metallic substances are mineralized 1. Converted into a mineral. 2

inlines.v: MIN'ERALIZED, participle passive Deprived of its usual properties by being combined with another substance or formed into an ore; as, metallic substances are mineralized 1. Converted into a mineral. 2. Impregnated with a mineral.
